user.title: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
user.description:
Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh 🌙

Welcome to **Prayer Times** for Home Assistant.

This integration uses the free **AlAdhan API** (aladhan.com) to provide accurate daily prayer times based on your location. We are truly grateful for this wonderful free service — may Allah reward those who built and maintain it.

Please enter your city and country to get started.

tarhim.title: Tarhim (تَرْحِيم) - Ramadan only
tarhim.description: Tarhim is a melodious recitation played before Fajr during Ramadan to wake people for Suhoor. It will play 6.5 minutes before Fajr automatically.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Receive a push notification when a prayer time starts or when prayer times are updated.

data.notify_on_update: Notify when prayer times are updated

reminders.title: Pre-Adhan Reminders
reminders.description: Play a sound and/or spoken message before each prayer time. Use {minutes} and {prayer} in your message.
